title: Fourth-root power inequality
statement:
For every natural number $k$ and real numbers $r,\varepsilon$ with $6/5\le r$ and $\varepsilon\ge0$,
\[
\left(\frac{k r^{3k}\sqrt{\varepsilon}}{3}\right)^{1/4}\le r^{2k}\varepsilon^{1/8}.
\]
